Hawks 111Hornets 97

Johnson and 12 steals carry Atlanta

Final · Fri, Nov 20 · Atlanta

Atlanta beat Charlotte 111–97, a 14-point home win. The Hawks move to 10–6; the Hornets fall to 4–11.
